pages.title: Making Black Steel
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)3 Deep Iron + 1 Infuscolium = 4 Black Steel

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 976 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 3.$(br)Mining efficiency: 6.6.$(br)Material damage bonus: 3.9.$(br)Enchantability: 11.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 2, chestplate 3, leggings 3, boots 2.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 6.5.$(br)Enchantability: 2.

pages.title: Armor: Reinforcement
pages.text: Receiving damage sometimes grants resistance but also slowness, at the same time. ( Repeated strikes stack the effect, aka slowness I and resistance I become slowness II and resistance II. Can stack up to 3 times, chance based.)

pages.title: Weapon: Mountain
pages.text: Tools & weapons act like armor, for example holding a black steel sword while getting attacked will damage the sword but absorb a small portion of the damage.
